Authentic Vietnamese Vegetarian Food
Mar 2016 • Family
Our guide brought us to Hoa Khai when she learned we were vegetarian. The decor is simple and unassuming, with photos depicting Vietnamese Buddhist imagery. The food was great, the choices were varied; the menu was in Vietnamese, so our guide was truly a guide! Local frequent this restaurant and No other westerners came in while we were having lunch. We loved our food and the prices were quite reasonable.

One of the best pure vegetarian restaurants so far
Sep 2015 • Solo
I ordered Bun Cha Gio and a fresh coconut for just 56,000 VND in total. And it even turned out to be one of the best vegetarian meals I had so far in Saigon :-)

Besides that, the restaurant looks very new. Seats, tables and especially chopsticks were clean. They have an outside area with fans as well as an indoor one with AC. Really one of the hidden treasures. I'll definitely come back!

Essential
Jan 2015 • Couples
I have eaten here many many times, and I have always eat well enough. It's also relatively cheap.
I like there most because there are not many tourist and a lot of local people, including monks that come to eat here often. I also enjoy the pray, which is played like a music in the background. Nothing extravagant, very basic food, but with a real Vietnamese flavor.. Don't expect a romantic dinner, but an experience to take.

Vegetarian heaven
Feb 2014 • Couples
Near the backpacker area, couple of minutes walking, and no drunken teenager in sight, yahoo - just this vegetarian restaurant with its about 100 different vegan dishes... The menu is in English as well. Lots of mock meats and tofus. But also different hot pots and very good salads bursting with taste and fresh herbs. Seats outside and inside. Highly recommended! We returned there... just so yummy vegan food and lots of options!
